chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam and others, from Abān, from some of his companions, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام used to say: “If the incisor becomes blackened, compensation is assigned for it.”

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَا: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, the authority from whom the ruling is transmitted
key_terms.اسْوَدَّتِ: became blackened; indicating visible damage or discoloration
key_terms.الدِّيَةُ: financial compensation due for bodily injury

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if an incisor tooth becomes blackened due to injury in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling concerning bodily injury and financial compensation. It states that when an incisor is blackened due to injury, a diyah is imposed for that damage.
